## Analysis

`sol_0011` closes the remaining wider modular-residue gap: widths 9–40 with mutable fringes still converge to `sol_0005`. Together with four earlier failures, this strongly refutes periodic-core refinement as the next productive direction. Exact-score annealing also appears representation-trapped; successful jumps have come only from changing the construction family. The unexplored opportunity is nonperiodic hierarchical digit structure with controlled carries between multiple scales, rather than a single modulus or carry-free Cartesian product.
